description:
This 2007 Mercedes-Benz CLK 63 AMG Cabriolet with Iridium Silver, black leather, and walnut wood trim is in excellent condition and ready for its next owner to enjoy it as much as I have. The power and performance is not for the faint of heart.

Please refer to the original window sticker photograph for all features. I also have a luxurious, fitted red cover, the wind deflector, a set of manuals, and two sets of keys.

It has always been parked in a secure garage.

I'm selling this car because I'm moving out of town and needed a large SUV. I'm going to miss the CLK though. It's my all-time favorite automobile to have owned. It's my second one. It will only go fast. The naturally aspirated engine's sound is deep but refined. Be sure to buy a high-end radar detector so that you can enjoy cruise control at 100mph on your trips to Florida. It's very rare when you have to tap on the brakes while going through a curve because this CLK 63 sticks to the road like you can't believe -- total control.

It has always been serviced at the original owner's Austin, Texas, Mercedes-Benz dealership and then, after I purchased it with 18,000 miles in 2018, it has always been serviced at Mercedes-Benz of Music City for 100% of every scheduled maintenance and for 100% of the repairs, including new tires. Everything that was recommended by the dealership has been performed. The only open problem is that the driver's heated seat is inoperable because a new heating element replacement part is not available from M-B, but I have a boutique shop searching for an alternative part now. Also, the Carfax will report two accidents, both of which were minor scrapes in parking lots. I can show you pictures and videos.

Recent 2025 maintenance Includes:
- Brand new tires (Michelin Pilot Sport 4 S)
- New brakes and rotors
- New radiator
- New intake manifold
- New fuel pump
- New motor mounts
- New axle
